items.question_text:
AI (artificial intelligence 人工智能)技术已经融入了我们生活中的方方面面。假设你是九年级的李华，学校正在举办科技节，你应邀参加以“AI has changed our lives”为主题的演讲比赛。请你结合自身或他人经历，用英语写一篇不少于 60 词的短文，介绍 AI 给生活带来的至少两方面的变化及你对 AI 技术的观点。
(注意: 1. 文中不得出现姓名、校名等个人信息，否则不予评分。2. 照抄阅读语篇不得分。)
items.student_answer: Hello, everyone. Nowadays, the AI technology has changed our lives a lot. For example, we can search for the information conveniently by asking AI. In addition, AI can communicate with us so that we won't feel very bored. Therefore, AI helps us a lot. In my opinion, the AI technology is not only wonderful but also dangerous. Some people will use AI (60) to do something harmful to people, on the Internet. We should be careful when we are surffing on the Internet. Thank you very much.

passages.material_text:
(A)
Have you ever heard about World Braille Day? It is celebrated {{17}} January 4th each year to show respect for Louis Braille. He was an inventor who had a great influence on blind people.
Braille became blind {{18}} he was a child. So his parents sent him to a school where he learned by listening. At the age of 10, he got a chance to learn a special writing system. It consisted of 12 raised dots(点). Different groups of dots stood for different letters. “What {{19}} amazing idea!” Braille thought. In the following years, he further {{20}} the system and developed a new one using only six dots, helping the blind read much more easily.
Today, Braille is greatly respected worldwide, for his curiosity and hard work have brought light to the dark world.

questions.solve_reasoning: 表示具体某一天或具体日期前，要用介词on。题干中“January 4th”是具体日期，所以应填on，构成“on January 4th each year”。at常用于时刻，in常用于月份、年份或较长时间范围。
句意是“Braille在他还是个孩子的时候失明了”。when表示“当……的时候”，符合时间状语从句。unless表示“除非”，because表示“因为”，都不符合上下文逻辑，所以选when。
句子是感叹句“What an amazing idea!”中心词idea是可数名词单数，前面要加不定冠词；amazing以元音音素开头，所以要用an。a用于辅音音素开头的词前，零冠词则不符合语法。
根据前文“At the age of 10”和“In the following years”可知，文章整体在讲过去发生的事情，所以要用一般过去时。studied与developed时态一致，最符合语境。studies是一般现在时，has studied是现在完成时，不合适。
根据选项看，本题考查并列连词辨析。or表示“或者”，so表示“所以”，but表示“但是”。在中考完形中，如果前后句存在转折关系，最常见答案是but。结合语法功能和常见语境，选but较合理。
本题考查情态动词辨析。can表示“能够”；need表示“需要”；must表示“必须”。若句子表达能力、可能性或客观可行性，通常用can最自然。结合中考常见设空方式，选can更符合基本语义和用法。
本题考查非谓语动词。to make常可作目的状语，表示“为了……”；make是动词原形，常跟在情态动词或使役动词后；making常作主语、宾语或介词后成分。中考完形里若表示目的，通常应填to make。
They是主格，作主语；Them是宾格，作宾语；Their是形容词性物主代词，后面接名词。如果空后有名词，需要用Their来修饰。此类题常通过代词在句中的成分来判断，因此选Their更合理。

passages.material_text:
The travel preferences of five foreign friends:
★ Maria is interested in history and old buildings. She wants to visit a famous place and learn about the life in the past.
★ David needs a quiet place without big crowds. He would love to go hiking in the mountains and see wonderful views of nature.
★ Lily enjoys busy and exciting cities. She wants to go shopping, see tall buildings, and enjoy foods from different countries.
★ Ben loves the ocean. His favourite way to spend holiday is to rest on a beach and try different water sports.
★ Emily is an artist and a coffee lover. She loves walking along brightly-coloured streets and taking photographs of beautiful scenes.

The six places in China:
A. It is a perfect place for a beach holiday. You can walk on the soft white sand, swim in the sea, or try riding the waves.
B. It is a peaceful place to enjoy nature. You can see high mountains, strange-shaped rocks, and beautiful clouds there.
C. You can find a famous palace here. The palace was built over 600 years ago and is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese architecture. You can see lots of historical and cultural works there.
D. This place attracts many tourists every year. You can take a boat trip along the river. It looks like something from a Chinese painting.
E. It's an old town known for its unique style and colourful streets. The traditional houses and gates are very beautiful. There is a large art market and many pretty cafés.
F. This city is full of life. It has some of China's tallest and most famous buildings, different kinds of shops, and restaurants that serve foods from all over the world.

questions.solve_reasoning: Maria喜欢历史和古建筑，想参观著名地点并了解过去的生活。选项C提到著名宫殿、600多年前建成、古代建筑杰作以及历史文化作品，完全符合她的需求，因此Maria应匹配C。
David需要安静、少人群的地方，还想去山里徒步并看自然风景。选项B描述“peaceful place”“high mountains”“beautiful clouds”，与他的旅行偏好高度一致，所以应选择B。
Lily喜欢繁忙又令人兴奋的城市，想购物、看高楼并品尝各国美食。选项F说这座城市充满活力，有高楼、各种商店和来自世界各地的餐馆，和她的兴趣完全对应，因此选F。
Ben喜爱海洋，假期最喜欢在海滩休息并尝试水上运动。选项A提到白色沙滩、海里游泳和冲浪等活动，正好与Ben的爱好一致，因此答案是A，匹配非常直接。
Emily是艺术爱好者，也喜欢咖啡，爱在色彩鲜艳的街道上散步并拍照。选项E提到古镇、彩色街道、艺术市场和漂亮咖啡馆，几乎与Emily的每一项偏好都吻合，所以选E。

passages.material_text:
As a young piano player and a 7th-grader, Toby has always been curious about the effects of music on people. He has done many tests on this. When he learned that people find it hard to focus, he wondered, "Could music help us improve attention?"
This 14-year-old boy started to search online for the effects of different kinds of music. He wanted to find out if listening to certain kinds of sounds could make people more focused. He then started an online test. He asked 65 people to play a computer game — they had to press a key when they saw certain numbers. Those people were divided into three groups. During the game, one group played in silence. Another group listened to a song from a video game. The third group heard a different tone (音调) in each ear, which created a special beating sound.
After the test, Toby compared the results. He found that the group with the special two-tone sound did the best. The group with the video game music did the worst. Although the results weren't strong enough to be completely sure, Toby didn't see that as a failure. For him, it was a starting point for more learning. "If you try something and it doesn't work, that's not a problem," he said. "It's part of the study process."
Later, Toby's project won him a prize in a national science contest. He hopes his work will help students discover new ways to focus when they study.

Vicky, a 14-year-old schoolgirl, was having difficulty with a piece of writing in English. She thought hard but achieved nothing, so she asked her teacher for some ideas to get started. In the end, she wrote one of her best pieces of work. She was really pleased that she had asked for help.
Everyone finds things difficult sometimes — Vicky is not the only one. Learning how to ask others to lend a hand is an important life skill.
When you might need help
There are lots of reasons why you could need help, such as having trouble with schoolwork or learning a new skill. When you're finding something difficult, or it's taking a long time to make progress, asking for help will move you forward more quickly than {{57}}.
What stops you asking for help
Asking for help isn't always easy. It can be tricky if you're not sure who to ask because you might think they won't want to help or they haven't got the time. If you think asking for a helping hand is a sign of weakness, it makes it even harder to turn to another person.
Asking for support is brave
Asking for help is an act of bravery. It takes great courage to let someone in, trust them with your story and ask them to help you deal with a problem.
When you ask for help, you won't face the pressure alone. As an old saying goes, "A problem shared is a problem halved." There are other benefits too. By asking for help, you learn to express what you need. You can also put yourself in others' shoes and be more able to offer a helping hand when someone needs it.

questions.question_text: Who gave Vicky some ideas about writing?
questions.correct_answer: Her teacher gave her some ideas about writing.
questions.solve_reasoning: 根据第一段“She asked her teacher for some ideas to get started.”可知，Vicky向老师求助，是老师给了她写作思路。这类题目要回到原文定位人物和动作，再用完整英语句子作答即可。

questions.question_text: How did Vicky feel after she asked for help?
questions.solve_reasoning: 原文最后一句写道“She was really pleased that she had asked for help.”，说明Vicky在求助后感到非常高兴、满意。回答时可直接提取原文关键词really pleased，表达准确又简洁。

questions.question_text: What can be filled in Blank 57?
questions.correct_answer: trying to do it on your own
questions.solve_reasoning: 句子意思是“当你遇到困难时，求助会比自己硬撑更快推动你前进”。因此空格应填与“独自完成、靠自己解决”相关的内容。trying to do it on your own既符合逻辑，也与上下文主题“ask for help”形成对比。

questions.question_text: When do people feel it harder to turn to others for help?
questions.correct_answer: When they think asking for help is a sign of weakness.
questions.solve_reasoning: 文中说“If you think asking for a helping hand is a sign of weakness, it makes it even harder to turn to another person.” 所以，当人们认为求助是软弱的表现时，就会更难向别人开口。答题要抓住因果句中的核心信息。

questions.question_text: What are the benefits of asking for help? (List two points)
questions.student_answer: 1. Learning to express what you need. 2. Put yourself in other's shoe.
questions.correct_answer: You learn to express what you need, and you become more able to help others.
questions.solve_reasoning: 最后一段明确写到两点好处：一是“you learn to express what you need”，二是“be more able to offer a helping hand when someone needs it”。答题时列出任意两点即可，注意用并列结构表达更清楚。

Women Who Led the Way
by Mick Manning and Brita Granström
(Otter-Barry Books)
Discover the stories of 21 amazing adventurers, explorers and travellers, including Aud the Deep-Minded, an early voyager to Iceland; Mae Jemison, the first black woman in space; and Arunima Sinha, the first woman amputee to climb Mount Everest.

When Darwin Sailed the Sea
by David Long
Illustrated by Sam Kalda
(Wide Eyed Editions)
When Charles Darwin climbed aboard the HMS Beagle, he set sail on a journey of exploration that would change the way we view the world.
Published to celebrate the 200th anniversary of the ship's launch, this book includes details about species he discovered on his travels and his important scientific theories.

Corpse Talk: Ground-breaking Explorers
by Adam and Lisa Murphy
(David Fickling Books)
Get to know some of history's most outstanding explorers with this fact-filled and funny comic book. In some interesting "interviews", you'll meet Ferdinand Magellan, Amelia Earhart and Ernest Shackleton, among others.

Explorers
by Nellie Huang and Jessamy Hawke
(Dorling Kindersley)
Featuring 50 brave real-life explorers and their amazing adventures, this book is filled with maps, photographs and artworks. You'll learn about all sorts of people through the ages, including intrepid Viking explorer Leif Erikson and Jeanne Baret, the first woman to sail around the world.

根据所在句“Featuring 50 brave real-life explorers...”以及上下文冒险家的语境，可推断intrepid意为“勇敢的、无畏的”，与brave意思最接近。

Wonderful Christmas Gift
Christmas was so close, and so was Ann's birthday. She wished she could get a new dress with frills (荷叶边) and lace (蕾丝) as a wonderful Christmas gift. But Ann did not want to ask her mom for that. She knew how hard her mom worked to make a living. Maybe she could make a wish -- maybe Santa Claus (圣诞老人) would come...
At school her classmates were talking only about Christmas celebrations. "My rich aunt is surely going to give me a pretty doll again." said Ria.
“I have been hinting (暗示) about that costly watch to my parents.” told Tessie.
Ann felt out of these conversations. She had neither rich parents nor wealthy aunts to give her expensive gifts.
It was not just the gift that worried Ann. It was her mother. Recently she was working overtime and looked pale and worn out.
Soon it was Christmas Eve. In everyone's house there was a decorated Christmas tree, but Ann's house was cold and empty. Every child went to bed eagerly waiting for the lovely gifts. Ann went to bed, wishing that at least this time she would get a gift from Santa Claus. Ann slowly drifted off to sleep. She dreamed of Santa riding in the snow...
The next morning, Ann jumped up after hearing her alarm. Out of her expectation, there lay a beautiful packet tied with a red ribbon near her bed. Inside the package was a pretty white dress with fluffy frills and attractive lace!
Ann checked the gift carefully to find out who had given her this beautiful dress. Suddenly a small piece of paper fell out from the dress.
Dear Ann, This dress is gifted to you for being a good girl. Hope you continue to do good things and help your mother.
Your Loving friend, Santa Claus
Ann felt that there was something familiar about this note. She looked into the note carefully. Then it struck her. She realized that {{82}}. Her mother had worked overtime to save money to buy this expensive gift. Ann was happy beyond words. She knew that she was the luckiest girl to have been given the best Christmas gift.

questions.student_answer: A new dress with frills and lace.
questions.correct_answer: She wanted a new dress with frills and lace.
questions.solve_reasoning: 根据首段“She wished she could get a new dress with frills and lace”可直接作答。回答时抓住礼物内容即可，不必展开过多细节。

questions.correct_answer: Because she had neither rich parents nor wealthy aunts to give her expensive gifts.
questions.solve_reasoning: 题目问她为什么无法融入同学们的谈话。文中紧接着说明她没有富有的父母，也没有有钱的姑姨送她昂贵礼物，因此感到格格不入。

questions.question_text: "Ann was only worried about her Christmas gift, wasn't she?"
questions.solve_reasoning: 这是反意疑问句作答。文中明确说“It was not just the gift that worried Ann. It was her mother.”说明她担心的不只是礼物，所以应回答否定。

questions.student_answer: Ann's house was cold and empty while ther was a decorated christmas tree in other people's house.
questions.correct_answer: Other people's houses had decorated Christmas trees, but Ann's house was cold and empty.
questions.solve_reasoning: 根据文中对比句“In everyone's house there was a decorated Christmas tree, but Ann's house was cold and empty.”可概括作答，突出“别人家有圣诞树，她家冷清空荡”。

questions.question_text: Complete the sentence in the last paragraph. She realized that {{82}}
questions.student_answer: She realized that this note was written by her mother.
questions.correct_answer: the gift was from her mother, not Santa Claus
questions.solve_reasoning: 她觉得纸条很熟悉，仔细看后突然明白，这份礼物并不是真正的圣诞老人送的，而是妈妈加班攒钱买给她的，所以这样补全最符合文意。

questions.student_answer: Because her mother had worked overtime to save money to buy this expensive gift for her and she could feel her mother's love.
questions.correct_answer: Because it showed her mother's love and hard work for her.
questions.solve_reasoning: 安觉得这是最好的圣诞礼物，不只是因为裙子漂亮，更因为她知道这是妈妈辛苦加班、省钱为她买的，里面包含了深深的母爱。

selected_passage.material_text:
(A)
Have you ever heard about World Braille Day? It is celebrated {{17}} January 4th each year to show respect for Louis Braille. He was an inventor who had a great influence on blind people.
Braille became blind {{18}} he was a child. So his parents sent him to a school where he learned by listening. At the age of 10, he got a chance to learn a special writing system. It consisted of 12 raised dots(点). Different groups of dots stood for different letters. “What {{19}} amazing idea!” Braille thought. In the following years, he further {{20}} the system and developed a new one using only six dots, helping the blind read much more easily.
Today, Braille is greatly respected worldwide, for his curiosity and hard work have brought light to the dark world.

questions.solve_reasoning: 表示具体某一天或具体日期前，要用介词on。题干中“January 4th”是具体日期，所以应填on，构成“on January 4th each year”。at常用于时刻，in常用于月份、年份或较长时间范围。
句意是“Braille在他还是个孩子的时候失明了”。when表示“当……的时候”，符合时间状语从句。unless表示“除非”，because表示“因为”，都不符合上下文逻辑，所以选when。
句子是感叹句“What an amazing idea!”中心词idea是可数名词单数，前面要加不定冠词；amazing以元音音素开头，所以要用an。a用于辅音音素开头的词前，零冠词则不符合语法。
根据前文“At the age of 10”和“In the following years”可知，文章整体在讲过去发生的事情，所以要用一般过去时。studied与developed时态一致，最符合语境。studies是一般现在时，has studied是现在完成时，不合适。
根据选项看，本题考查并列连词辨析。or表示“或者”，so表示“所以”，but表示“但是”。在中考完形中，如果前后句存在转折关系，最常见答案是but。结合语法功能和常见语境，选but较合理。
本题考查情态动词辨析。can表示“能够”；need表示“需要”；must表示“必须”。若句子表达能力、可能性或客观可行性，通常用can最自然。结合中考常见设空方式，选can更符合基本语义和用法。
本题考查非谓语动词。to make常可作目的状语，表示“为了……”；make是动词原形，常跟在情态动词或使役动词后；making常作主语、宾语或介词后成分。中考完形里若表示目的，通常应填to make。
They是主格，作主语；Them是宾格，作宾语；Their是形容词性物主代词，后面接名词。如果空后有名词，需要用Their来修饰。此类题常通过代词在句中的成分来判断，因此选Their更合理。

items.question_text:
AI (artificial intelligence 人工智能)技术已经融入了我们生活中的方方面面。假设你是九年级的李华，学校正在举办科技节，你应邀参加以“AI has changed our lives”为主题的演讲比赛。请你结合自身或他人经历，用英语写一篇不少于 60 词的短文，介绍 AI 给生活带来的至少两方面的变化及你对 AI 技术的观点。
(注意: 1. 文中不得出现姓名、校名等个人信息，否则不予评分。2. 照抄阅读语篇不得分。)
items.student_answer: Hello, everyone. Nowadays, the AI technology has changed our lives a lot. For example, we can search for the information conveniently by asking AI. In addition, AI can communicate with us so that we won't feel very bored. Therefore, AI helps us a lot. In my opinion, the AI technology is not only wonderful but also dangerous. Some people will use AI (60) to do something harmful to people, on the Internet. We should be careful when we are surffing on the Internet. Thank you very much.

passages.material_text:
(A)
Have you ever heard about World Braille Day? It is celebrated {{17}} January 4th each year to show respect for Louis Braille. He was an inventor who had a great influence on blind people.
Braille became blind {{18}} he was a child. So his parents sent him to a school where he learned by listening. At the age of 10, he got a chance to learn a special writing system. It consisted of 12 raised dots(点). Different groups of dots stood for different letters. “What {{19}} amazing idea!” Braille thought. In the following years, he further {{20}} the system and developed a new one using only six dots, helping the blind read much more easily.
Today, Braille is greatly respected worldwide, for his curiosity and hard work have brought light to the dark world.

questions.solve_reasoning: 表示具体某一天或具体日期前，要用介词on。题干中“January 4th”是具体日期，所以应填on，构成“on January 4th each year”。at常用于时刻，in常用于月份、年份或较长时间范围。
句意是“Braille在他还是个孩子的时候失明了”。when表示“当……的时候”，符合时间状语从句。unless表示“除非”，because表示“因为”，都不符合上下文逻辑，所以选when。
句子是感叹句“What an amazing idea!”中心词idea是可数名词单数，前面要加不定冠词；amazing以元音音素开头，所以要用an。a用于辅音音素开头的词前，零冠词则不符合语法。
根据前文“At the age of 10”和“In the following years”可知，文章整体在讲过去发生的事情，所以要用一般过去时。studied与developed时态一致，最符合语境。studies是一般现在时，has studied是现在完成时，不合适。
根据选项看，本题考查并列连词辨析。or表示“或者”，so表示“所以”，but表示“但是”。在中考完形中，如果前后句存在转折关系，最常见答案是but。结合语法功能和常见语境，选but较合理。
本题考查情态动词辨析。can表示“能够”；need表示“需要”；must表示“必须”。若句子表达能力、可能性或客观可行性，通常用can最自然。结合中考常见设空方式，选can更符合基本语义和用法。
本题考查非谓语动词。to make常可作目的状语，表示“为了……”；make是动词原形，常跟在情态动词或使役动词后；making常作主语、宾语或介词后成分。中考完形里若表示目的，通常应填to make。
They是主格，作主语；Them是宾格，作宾语；Their是形容词性物主代词，后面接名词。如果空后有名词，需要用Their来修饰。此类题常通过代词在句中的成分来判断，因此选Their更合理。

passages.material_text:
The travel preferences of five foreign friends:
★ Maria is interested in history and old buildings. She wants to visit a famous place and learn about the life in the past.
★ David needs a quiet place without big crowds. He would love to go hiking in the mountains and see wonderful views of nature.
★ Lily enjoys busy and exciting cities. She wants to go shopping, see tall buildings, and enjoy foods from different countries.
★ Ben loves the ocean. His favourite way to spend holiday is to rest on a beach and try different water sports.
★ Emily is an artist and a coffee lover. She loves walking along brightly-coloured streets and taking photographs of beautiful scenes.

The six places in China:
A. It is a perfect place for a beach holiday. You can walk on the soft white sand, swim in the sea, or try riding the waves.
B. It is a peaceful place to enjoy nature. You can see high mountains, strange-shaped rocks, and beautiful clouds there.
C. You can find a famous palace here. The palace was built over 600 years ago and is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese architecture. You can see lots of historical and cultural works there.
D. This place attracts many tourists every year. You can take a boat trip along the river. It looks like something from a Chinese painting.
E. It's an old town known for its unique style and colourful streets. The traditional houses and gates are very beautiful. There is a large art market and many pretty cafés.
F. This city is full of life. It has some of China's tallest and most famous buildings, different kinds of shops, and restaurants that serve foods from all over the world.

questions.solve_reasoning: Maria喜欢历史和古建筑，想参观著名地点并了解过去的生活。选项C提到著名宫殿、600多年前建成、古代建筑杰作以及历史文化作品，完全符合她的需求，因此Maria应匹配C。
David需要安静、少人群的地方，还想去山里徒步并看自然风景。选项B描述“peaceful place”“high mountains”“beautiful clouds”，与他的旅行偏好高度一致，所以应选择B。
Lily喜欢繁忙又令人兴奋的城市，想购物、看高楼并品尝各国美食。选项F说这座城市充满活力，有高楼、各种商店和来自世界各地的餐馆，和她的兴趣完全对应，因此选F。
Ben喜爱海洋，假期最喜欢在海滩休息并尝试水上运动。选项A提到白色沙滩、海里游泳和冲浪等活动，正好与Ben的爱好一致，因此答案是A，匹配非常直接。
Emily是艺术爱好者，也喜欢咖啡，爱在色彩鲜艳的街道上散步并拍照。选项E提到古镇、彩色街道、艺术市场和漂亮咖啡馆，几乎与Emily的每一项偏好都吻合，所以选E。

passages.material_text:
As a young piano player and a 7th-grader, Toby has always been curious about the effects of music on people. He has done many tests on this. When he learned that people find it hard to focus, he wondered, "Could music help us improve attention?"
This 14-year-old boy started to search online for the effects of different kinds of music. He wanted to find out if listening to certain kinds of sounds could make people more focused. He then started an online test. He asked 65 people to play a computer game — they had to press a key when they saw certain numbers. Those people were divided into three groups. During the game, one group played in silence. Another group listened to a song from a video game. The third group heard a different tone (音调) in each ear, which created a special beating sound.
After the test, Toby compared the results. He found that the group with the special two-tone sound did the best. The group with the video game music did the worst. Although the results weren't strong enough to be completely sure, Toby didn't see that as a failure. For him, it was a starting point for more learning. "If you try something and it doesn't work, that's not a problem," he said. "It's part of the study process."
Later, Toby's project won him a prize in a national science contest. He hopes his work will help students discover new ways to focus when they study.

questions.question_text: Toby {{42}} right after he searched for information online.
questions.solve_reasoning: 文章第二段明确写道：Toby在网上搜索相关信息之后，“He then started an online test.”，也就是“接着开展了一项在线测试”。因此right after he searched for information online后做的事情是set up an online test，选A。

questions.question_text: The "special beating sound" in paragraph 2 came from {{43}}.

options.text: playing a song from a video game
options.label: B

options.text: hearing a different tone in each ear
options.label: C

options.text: feeling the heartbeat in a quiet room
options.label: D

questions.solve_reasoning: 原文说“The third group heard a different tone in each ear, which created a special beating sound.” 可见这种特殊拍击声来自“两只耳朵听到不同音调”。因此答案是C，属于原文直接信息题。

questions.question_text: The results of Toby's test show that {{44}}.

options.text: the two-tone sound helps people focus best
options.label: A

options.text: people work better in a silent room
options.label: B

options.text: video game music relaxes people more
options.label: C

options.text: music has no effects on any group
options.label: D

questions.solve_reasoning: 第三段提到“Toby found that the group with the special two-tone sound did the best.” 也就是听到特殊双音调声音的那组表现最好，所以测试结果表明这种声音最能帮助人集中注意力，选A。

questions.question_text: What can you learn from Toby's story?

options.text: Two heads are better than one.
options.label: C

questions.solve_reasoning: Toby因为对“音乐是否能提高专注力”感到好奇，便主动查资料、设计实验、参加比赛，最终还获奖。这说明好奇心能带来新的探索和可能性，所以“Curiosity brings possibilities.”最符合文章主旨，选B。

questions.question_text: In which part of a magazine can you most probably find this text?
questions.solve_reasoning: 文章内容围绕实验、测试、结果分析和全国科学竞赛展开，主题明显属于科学研究与发现，而不是体育、文化或旅游。因此最可能出现在杂志的Science版块，答案选D。

passages.material_text:
Vicky, a 14-year-old schoolgirl, was having difficulty with a piece of writing in English. She thought hard but achieved nothing, so she asked her teacher for some ideas to get started. In the end, she wrote one of her best pieces of work. She was really pleased that she had asked for help.
Everyone finds things difficult sometimes — Vicky is not the only one. Learning how to ask others to lend a hand is an important life skill.
When you might need help
There are lots of reasons why you could need help, such as having trouble with schoolwork or learning a new skill. When you're finding something difficult, or it's taking a long time to make progress, asking for help will move you forward more quickly than {{57}}.
What stops you asking for help
Asking for help isn't always easy. It can be tricky if you're not sure who to ask because you might think they won't want to help or they haven't got the time. If you think asking for a helping hand is a sign of weakness, it makes it even harder to turn to another person.
Asking for support is brave
Asking for help is an act of bravery. It takes great courage to let someone in, trust them with your story and ask them to help you deal with a problem.
When you ask for help, you won't face the pressure alone. As an old saying goes, "A problem shared is a problem halved." There are other benefits too. By asking for help, you learn to express what you need. You can also put yourself in others' shoes and be more able to offer a helping hand when someone needs it.

questions.question_text: Who gave Vicky some ideas about writing?
questions.correct_answer: Her teacher gave her some ideas about writing.
questions.solve_reasoning: 根据第一段“She asked her teacher for some ideas to get started.”可知，Vicky向老师求助，是老师给了她写作思路。这类题目要回到原文定位人物和动作，再用完整英语句子作答即可。

questions.question_text: How did Vicky feel after she asked for help?
questions.solve_reasoning: 原文最后一句写道“She was really pleased that she had asked for help.”，说明Vicky在求助后感到非常高兴、满意。回答时可直接提取原文关键词really pleased，表达准确又简洁。

questions.question_text: What can be filled in Blank 57?
questions.correct_answer: trying to do it on your own
questions.solve_reasoning: 句子意思是“当你遇到困难时，求助会比自己硬撑更快推动你前进”。因此空格应填与“独自完成、靠自己解决”相关的内容。trying to do it on your own既符合逻辑，也与上下文主题“ask for help”形成对比。

questions.question_text: When do people feel it harder to turn to others for help?
questions.correct_answer: When they think asking for help is a sign of weakness.
questions.solve_reasoning: 文中说“If you think asking for a helping hand is a sign of weakness, it makes it even harder to turn to another person.” 所以，当人们认为求助是软弱的表现时，就会更难向别人开口。答题要抓住因果句中的核心信息。

questions.question_text: What are the benefits of asking for help? (List two points)
questions.student_answer: 1. Learning to express what you need. 2. Put yourself in other's shoe.
questions.correct_answer: You learn to express what you need, and you become more able to help others.
questions.solve_reasoning: 最后一段明确写到两点好处：一是“you learn to express what you need”，二是“be more able to offer a helping hand when someone needs it”。答题时列出任意两点即可，注意用并列结构表达更清楚。

passages.paper_name: 2025 学年度第一学期期中初三三年级 英语学科调研试卷
passages.material_text:
Women Who Led the Way
by Mick Manning and Brita Granström
(Otter-Barry Books)
Discover the stories of 21 amazing adventurers, explorers and travellers, including Aud the Deep-Minded, an early voyager to Iceland; Mae Jemison, the first black woman in space; and Arunima Sinha, the first woman amputee to climb Mount Everest.

When Darwin Sailed the Sea
by David Long
Illustrated by Sam Kalda
(Wide Eyed Editions)
When Charles Darwin climbed aboard the HMS Beagle, he set sail on a journey of exploration that would change the way we view the world.
Published to celebrate the 200th anniversary of the ship's launch, this book includes details about species he discovered on his travels and his important scientific theories.

Corpse Talk: Ground-breaking Explorers
by Adam and Lisa Murphy
(David Fickling Books)
Get to know some of history's most outstanding explorers with this fact-filled and funny comic book. In some interesting "interviews", you'll meet Ferdinand Magellan, Amelia Earhart and Ernest Shackleton, among others.

Explorers
by Nellie Huang and Jessamy Hawke
(Dorling Kindersley)
Featuring 50 brave real-life explorers and their amazing adventures, this book is filled with maps, photographs and artworks. You'll learn about all sorts of people through the ages, including intrepid Viking explorer Leif Erikson and Jeanne Baret, the first woman to sail around the world.

questions.question_text: In When Darwin Sailed the Sea, we can know that _______.

options.text: Darwin travelled around the world by ship and by land
options.label: A

options.text: Darwin began to travel around the world 21 hundred years ago
options.label: B

options.text: Darwin made a lot of important discoveries during his journey
options.label: C

options.text: Darwin put forward his famous theories even before his journey
options.label: D

questions.solve_reasoning: 文中提到这本书包含达尔文旅途中发现的物种细节和重要科学理论，因此说明他在旅程中有许多重要发现。C项与原文意思最吻合。

questions.question_text: You will not read anything about a woman in Book _______.
questions.solve_reasoning: A书专写女性探险者；C书中提到Amelia Earhart；D书中提到Jeanne Baret。只有B书主要介绍达尔文航海经历，没有提到女性，因此选B。
根据所在句“Featuring 50 brave real-life explorers...”以及上下文冒险家的语境，可推断intrepid意为“勇敢的、无畏的”，与brave意思最接近。

questions.question_text: Which of the following is right according to the passage?

options.text: Arunima Sinha was the first woman to climb Mount Everest.
options.label: A

options.text: Charles Darwin got on the HMS Beagle and started his journey.
options.label: B

options.text: Adam and Lisa Murphy wrote their book in a serious way.
options.label: C

options.text: Jeanne Baret was the first person to sail around the world.
options.label: D

questions.solve_reasoning: 原文明确说“When Charles Darwin climbed aboard the HMS Beagle, he set sail...”，即达尔文登上小猎犬号后开始旅程。其余三项都与原文不符。

questions.question_text: All the four books are about _______.
questions.solve_reasoning: 四本书都围绕探险家、航海家或旅行者展开，有男性也有女性，但共同主题是“勇敢的探险者”。因此A最能概括四本书的共同内容。

Wonderful Christmas Gift
Christmas was so close, and so was Ann's birthday. She wished she could get a new dress with frills (荷叶边) and lace (蕾丝) as a wonderful Christmas gift. But Ann did not want to ask her mom for that. She knew how hard her mom worked to make a living. Maybe she could make a wish -- maybe Santa Claus (圣诞老人) would come...
At school her classmates were talking only about Christmas celebrations. "My rich aunt is surely going to give me a pretty doll again." said Ria.
“I have been hinting (暗示) about that costly watch to my parents.” told Tessie.
Ann felt out of these conversations. She had neither rich parents nor wealthy aunts to give her expensive gifts.
It was not just the gift that worried Ann. It was her mother. Recently she was working overtime and looked pale and worn out.
Soon it was Christmas Eve. In everyone's house there was a decorated Christmas tree, but Ann's house was cold and empty. Every child went to bed eagerly waiting for the lovely gifts. Ann went to bed, wishing that at least this time she would get a gift from Santa Claus. Ann slowly drifted off to sleep. She dreamed of Santa riding in the snow...
The next morning, Ann jumped up after hearing her alarm. Out of her expectation, there lay a beautiful packet tied with a red ribbon near her bed. Inside the package was a pretty white dress with fluffy frills and attractive lace!
Ann checked the gift carefully to find out who had given her this beautiful dress. Suddenly a small piece of paper fell out from the dress.
Dear Ann, This dress is gifted to you for being a good girl. Hope you continue to do good things and help your mother.
Your Loving friend, Santa Claus
Ann felt that there was something familiar about this note. She looked into the note carefully. Then it struck her. She realized that {{82}}. Her mother had worked overtime to save money to buy this expensive gift. Ann was happy beyond words. She knew that she was the luckiest girl to have been given the best Christmas gift.

selected_passage.material_text:
(A)
Have you ever heard about World Braille Day? It is celebrated {{17}} January 4th each year to show respect for Louis Braille. He was an inventor who had a great influence on blind people.
Braille became blind {{18}} he was a child. So his parents sent him to a school where he learned by listening. At the age of 10, he got a chance to learn a special writing system. It consisted of 12 raised dots(点). Different groups of dots stood for different letters. “What {{19}} amazing idea!” Braille thought. In the following years, he further {{20}} the system and developed a new one using only six dots, helping the blind read much more easily.
Today, Braille is greatly respected worldwide, for his curiosity and hard work have brought light to the dark world.

questions.solve_reasoning: 表示具体某一天或具体日期前，要用介词on。题干中“January 4th”是具体日期，所以应填on，构成“on January 4th each year”。at常用于时刻，in常用于月份、年份或较长时间范围。
句意是“Braille在他还是个孩子的时候失明了”。when表示“当……的时候”，符合时间状语从句。unless表示“除非”，because表示“因为”，都不符合上下文逻辑，所以选when。
句子是感叹句“What an amazing idea!”中心词idea是可数名词单数，前面要加不定冠词；amazing以元音音素开头，所以要用an。a用于辅音音素开头的词前，零冠词则不符合语法。
根据前文“At the age of 10”和“In the following years”可知，文章整体在讲过去发生的事情，所以要用一般过去时。studied与developed时态一致，最符合语境。studies是一般现在时，has studied是现在完成时，不合适。
根据选项看，本题考查并列连词辨析。or表示“或者”，so表示“所以”，but表示“但是”。在中考完形中，如果前后句存在转折关系，最常见答案是but。结合语法功能和常见语境，选but较合理。
本题考查情态动词辨析。can表示“能够”；need表示“需要”；must表示“必须”。若句子表达能力、可能性或客观可行性，通常用can最自然。结合中考常见设空方式，选can更符合基本语义和用法。
本题考查非谓语动词。to make常可作目的状语，表示“为了……”；make是动词原形，常跟在情态动词或使役动词后；making常作主语、宾语或介词后成分。中考完形里若表示目的，通常应填to make。
They是主格，作主语；Them是宾格，作宾语；Their是形容词性物主代词，后面接名词。如果空后有名词，需要用Their来修饰。此类题常通过代词在句中的成分来判断，因此选Their更合理。
